lines: They broke on my hurdles and your bow. That's the night held.
And that was the one night. They came for this light and they've had their answer. They'll not come for it again.
entries.why: Matt, 13 Nov: the first night is a one-off, and Hale says so plainly. Nothing here promises a next lot or a bell: the bell tower is rebuilt later, for the wolf moon

lines: They put the lantern out. The shard's still in its cradle, mind, and we're still here.
It stays dark until we hold a night. They come the next time you walk into Crossroads, and you'll find me at the anvil.
entries.why: the stake (Matt, 13 Nov: "Shard dims until held"): after a lost night Hale says what was lost and how it comes back, in the lead's own words for when (data/leads.json: the next time you walk into Crossroads). Talking to her starts nothing, and she does not say it does. Priority 6: over her lines before the night (5)

lines: My hurdles are ready for the halt road, wherever you want them on the pads. They'll hold a while. The rest is your bow.
It's the shard they're after. Its light is the light that's in them. Keep them off the lantern and the night is ours.
Give me the word when you're ready, not before. Three on the anvil, and they'll know we're waiting.
The great shard sits dull in its cradle, its glass gone dark. It will not burn again until a night is held.
entries.why: the stake (Matt, 13 Nov: "Shard dims until held"): the lantern itself says it is dark and what lights it. The flag is cleared by a won night (core/raids.gd), so this never shows after one

lines: The great shard hums in its cradle, bright enough to see from the halt road. Whatever is out there is coming for it.
entries.why: one plain line at the lantern itself before the first night (Matt, 13 Nov: "why would i defend a lantern that's so odd"): what it holds and that they come for it. What becomes of it if the lantern breaks is Matt's answer of 13 Nov ("Shard dims until held"): the entry above, while shard_lantern_dark is set

lines: Their camp's still out on the halt road. I can see their eyes from the stall at dusk.
Hale's hurdles are ready whenever you are.
entries.why: priority 11 outranks Moss's act-1 lines (10), but only while the raid is put off and no quest of hers can start or run: her three act-1 quests start on talking to her and each needs the Frostline built first (Bread for the Col hut asks for zone_built:frostline; the choked well follows the bread, the landslip the wolf moon), so this line never shows while the Frostline is in the build
